title: Term Quiz
oneLiner: Ten multiple-choice questions, term to definition or definition to term, with wrong answers from the same topic.
keyTakeaway: Telling a term apart from its close neighbours (latency vs. throughput, PLC vs. RTU, authentication vs. authorization) is the real test of understanding, so the wrong answers here always come from the same topic.
explanation:
Choose a topic, or all of them, and a direction. Term to definition shows a term and four definitions; definition to term shows a definition and four terms. Every wrong option is from the same topic, so you can't rule options out just because they're about something else.

At the end you get your score and every term you missed with its definition. Look those up in the Glossary, then add them to your Flash Cards practice.
